items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Oh, yeah, Jonny was able to earn money in a nightclub.

ctx.x: Well let me just pick up — was it a point of conversation in your family that Jon is working in a nightclub?

Oh, yeah, Jonny was able to earn money in a nightclub. My father never saw me. My mother never saw me, because they sold liquor in nightclubs and they would never go. But I sang at banquets at times and they would come and they would see me. But my father won a car in the 30s when nobody had a car, and wouldn’t go into the movie house to get the car, because that is forbidden in the Bible.
I’m not following you on that.
